description: Defines an entity's melee attack and any additional effects on it.

damage.description: Range of the random amount of damage the melee attack deals. A negative value can heal the entity instead of hurting it.

effect_amplifier.description: Amplifier level (potion tier) of the status ailment applied to the damaged entity. Higher values increase the strength of the effect.

effect_duration.description: Duration in seconds of the status ailment applied to the damaged entity. Can also be "infinite".

effect_name.description: Identifier of the status ailment to apply to an entity attacked by this entity's melee attack.

title: minecraft:attack
